Randwick.rail_note: True rail = inside dominant; suits strong finishers (Randwick Rise ~250m). Barriers 1-6 ideal in sprints.

Kensington.rail_note: Tight circuit; strong on-pace bias, especially with the rail out. Weight front-runners and inside draws.

Flemington.rail_note: Longest straight in Australia. Straight Six (1000-1200m) no strong barrier bias; 1600m/2500m inside slightly advantaged.

Caulfield.rail_note: Tight turns, short straight. Penalize backmarkers in sprints; on-pace horses +10-15%. Rail position critical.

Rosehill.rail_note: Sharp home turn; front-runners favoured. Barrier 8+ disadvantaged at 1100m; wider than 10 struggles.

Eagle Farm.rail_note: Long straight; historically favours runners off the rail in the straight. Always check rail position.

Doomben.rail_note: Small tight track, short straight. Strong on-pace bias; leaders +15-20%, penalize backmarkers heavily.

Canterbury.rail_note: Night racing, very tight ~300m straight. Extreme leader bias; discount closers heavily.

Morphettville.rail_note: Spacious, one of the fairest tracks in Australia. Minimal bias adjustment needed.

Ascot.rail_note: Perth. ~70% winners from first 4 on the turn. Very strong on-pace weighting required.

Newcastle.rail_note: Generally fair; inside bias on the true rail.

Moonee Valley.rail_note: Very tight circuit, short 173m straight. On-pace advantage; hard to make ground from the back.

Pakenham.rail_note: Synthetic. Plays like Soft 5-6 turf; wet-track gallopers translate well. Minimal draw bias, fair for all styles.

Geelong.rail_note: Synthetic. Minimal draw bias; fair for all running styles.
